desktop_reference.note: Capability parity reference. Same sections, nav, AskFYD, contact info as mobile. Only layout collapses (grids to fewer columns, rail to FAB).

capture.method: Scripted CDP capture: playwright-core chromium.connectOverCDP('http://localhost:9223') executed by Windows-side node.exe (C:/Users/nolan/.local/share/pigi/node-v22.23.2-win-x64/node.exe) against the Pig headed Chrome (Chrome/153). New background tabs per width via browser.newPage() + page.setViewportSize(); no clicks or typing except one FAB click probe. Screenshots: fullPage PNG + viewport PNG per width. DOM analysis via page.evaluate (overflow walk, touch-target audit, nav/hero/CTA/section inventory, dialog inventory). No screenshots were faked or hand-drawn.

checklist.awkward_wrapping: PASS: no awkward breaks observed at any width; long email and phone values fit their lines.
checklist.card_repetition_narrow: PASS: every grid collapses to 1 card per row at all mobile widths (services grid, input pair grids).
checklist.contact_discoverability_note: Phone (tel:) link sits in Contact at ~2768 CSS px depth on 320; email and website alongside. Reachable but deep.
checklist.dead_visual_zones: FAIL: Services section holds ~600 CSS px of blank space at 320 (~1000 px at 1280) with five invisible cards (ISSUE-1).
checklist.hero_integrity_320: PASS: title wraps cleanly across two lines, no overflow, description readable on dark navy, both buttons side by side and above 44 px tall.
checklist.mobile_is_not_fyd_lite: PASS: mobile exposes the same sections, nav labels, AskFYD widget, contact channels, and customize panel as the 1280 reference. Differences are layout collapse only (grids to 1 col, object rail to FAB trigger).
checklist.mobile_overflow: PASS: hasHorizontalOverflow=false at 320, 360, 375, 390, 430. docScrollWidth below viewport width everywhere; zero overflow offender elements.
checklist.navigation_usability: PASS: 4 text links (Home, About, Services, Explore) fit at 320 with no overflow and no hamburger; active state visible. Demo banner sits above the site nav (demo chrome, not site chrome).
checklist.section_stacking_rhythm: FAIL overall: stacking is a consistent single column with even spacing, but the blank Services gap (ISSUE-1) breaks the rhythm between About and Where we work.
checklist.sheet_drawer_behavior: PASS with minor defect: FAB tap opens a bottom sheet (rounded-t-3xl, max-h 80vh, backdrop, visible close control, readable object card). Background scroll is not locked while open (ISSUE-6).
checklist.text_over_media_readability: N/A: zero images on the page, so no text-over-media instances exist. Hero is flat dark navy with white text and passes visual contrast inspection.
checklist.thumb_reachable_primary_cta: FAIL: the only fixed thumb-zone control is the Featured object FAB, which opens an object sheet rather than a contact action. The tel: CTA requires scrolling ~2800 px to Contact. Hero offers Visit website and Ask FYD only (ISSUE-3).
checklist.touch_targets_44px: FAIL: 31 sub-44 px targets at every mobile width: 10 service-card links render at 43 px tall (ISSUE-4); 18 builder proposal inputs and 3 color inputs render at 38 px tall (ISSUE-5).

context: The route renders a generated-site DEMO page: demo banner (FYD SOCIAL / Generated site demo / Procedural clone proof), then the generated site (Hero, About/BusinessSummary, Services, Where we work/Locations, Contact, Find us/Links, CTA, AskFYD, featured object), then a full Customize this site builder panel (per-section Up/Down/Hide, proposed heading/copy inputs, design token inputs). Critique covers the route as rendered.

issues.cause: The five .fyd-affordance-preview card elements exist in layout (about 198 px tall each at 320) but their innerText is empty and their 10 inner links (92 to 119 px wide, 43 px tall) carry no visible label. The cards paint as blank boxes, leaving roughly 600 CSS px of dead space at 320 and roughly 1000 px at 1280 between the Services heading and Where we work.
evidence: analysis JSON at all widths: dialogs[] has 5 fyd-affordance-preview entries with textStart ''
issues.regression_note: Add a permanent assertion: every .fyd-affordance-preview inside the Services section must have non-empty innerText and a painted height above 40 px at 320.
issues.title: Services section renders five empty cards and a large dead zone

issues.cause: The FAB is a fixed 153 px wide pill (bottom-6 right-6). At 320 px that is 48 percent of the viewport width; the About heading and paragraph occupy the same bottom-right viewport region on initial load, so the pill paints over readable text.
evidence: shots/happy-place-320-fold.png (pill covers 'Happy Place' in the About heading)
analysis JSON: identical fixed rect 153x44 at every mobile width
issues.regression_note: Add a permanent assertion: at 320, no fixed-position element may intersect the bounding box of a section heading in the initial viewport.
issues.title: Fixed Featured object FAB occludes About content at load

issues.cause: The phone link lives in the Contact section about 2800 CSS px below the fold at 320. The hero offers Visit website and Ask FYD, neither of which dials. No sticky or persistent call control exists in the component registry (no StickyCallBar).
evidence: analysis-320.json ctas[0]: tel: link at y=2768
fold screenshots at all widths: hero buttons are Visit website and Ask FYD
issues.regression_note: For TRADES archetype specs, assert a dial action is reachable within the first two viewport heights on mobile or via a persistent control.
issues.title: No thumb-reachable primary contact CTA on mobile

issues.cause: min-h-[44px] utility computes to a 43 px rendered height on these anchors (likely border or subpixel rounding in the box calculation). One pixel under the floor, on elements that are also invisible per ISSUE-1.
issues.regression_note: Assert interactive anchors and buttons measure at least 44 px in both dimensions at 320.
issues.title: Service-card action links render at 43 px tall, 1 px under the 44 px floor

evidence: shots/fab-320-after.png shows sheet open over dimmed page

parity_mobile_vs_desktop.customize_panel: present at both (larger type scale on desktop)
parity_mobile_vs_desktop.object_rail: in-flow featured card on desktop; collapsed to fixed FAB trigger on mobile (sheet verified working)

regression_320_notes: R1: every .fyd-affordance-preview inside the Services section must have non-empty innerText and painted height above 40 px (currently 5 empty boxes).
R2: keep the no-horizontal-overflow guard (currently passing at all widths).
R3: no fixed-position element may intersect a section heading box in the initial 320 viewport (FAB currently covers the About heading).
R4: all interactive anchors and buttons must measure at least 44 px in both dimensions (card links currently 43 px; builder inputs 38 px).
R5: opening the object sheet must set body overflow hidden (currently background stays scrollable).

sheet_probe.content: Featured object card for Painting/Service with description and provenance line
sheet_probe.overlay: fixed inset-0 z-50 backdrop dims page
sheet_probe.sheet: absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0, rounded-t-3xl, max-h 80vh, overflow-y auto, readable

summary.capture_status: COMPLETE: 6 of 6 widths captured via scripted CDP, plus FAB interaction probe. Zero console errors on every load.
top_3_failures: ISSUE-1: Services section renders five empty cards with ~600 px of dead space at 320 (critical; present at all widths including desktop)
ISSUE-2: Fixed Featured object FAB (153 px, 48 percent of a 320 viewport) occludes the About heading and paragraph on initial load (high at 320)
ISSUE-3: No thumb-reachable primary contact CTA; the tel: link sits ~2800 px deep in Contact and the hero offers no dial action (high for a trades site)
summary.worst_width_why: All mobile widths share the same six issues, but 320 suffers most: the fixed FAB covers 48 percent of viewport width (vs 36 percent at 430), the dead Services gap is proportionally largest, and the 43 px targets sit closest to the floor.
